name: ElevenLabs Scribe
description: Transcribes meetings with ElevenLabs Scribe, in the cloud. Each track is uploaded once the meeting ends; speakers are still told apart on your Mac.

elevenlabs.apiKey.description: From elevenlabs.io › Developers › API Keys. Kept in your keychain.

elevenlabs.keyterms.description: Names and terms Scribe should listen for, separated by commas. ElevenLabs charges 20% more when any are set.
